payload.description_html: Nagatitan is the largest known dinosaur from Southeast Asia, at approximately 27 m in length, and weighing around 27 t in total body mass. As a sauropod, it was a quadrupedal herbivore, using its long neck to reach vegetation, which it processed in its large gut. The discovery of Nagatitan has expanded known titanosauriform diversity within the region.
